content: {"like":["Values strong, believable performances from actors, especially in supporting roles;","Prefers realistic father-son dynamics and deep friendships;","Enjoys well-crafted action and revenge narratives with clear good vs. bad outcomes;","Appreciates shows that balance character development with strong supporting casts;","Likes visual and production quality—cinematography, costumes, and setting details."],"dislike":["Dislikes slow pacing that delays backstory;","Finds strong language by preteens and gratuitous nudity off-putting;","Avoids poorly executed special effects and confusing henchmen;","Rejects overblown egos and megalomaniac characters;","Prefers shows without tired or bored actors and with coherent writing."]}
